notes.title: AVAILABLE NOW FOR FREE!
notes.content:
After 8 months of on-and-off development, Half Hour Hexagon has finally been made available for FREE on Steam, Newgrounds, Itch.io, GX.Games, and more!

The game is a vampire survivors-inspired swarming roguelite with tons of stuff to find an unlock! The steam version of the game also includes Steam Achievement and Steam Leaderboard support :)

Get the game now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144080/Half_Hour_Hexagon/
